title: Emergent Social Conventions and Collective Bias in LLM Populations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability distribution of an isolated LLM agent selecting specific arbitrary tokens (e.g., alphabet letters or random strings) from a predefined pool during the first round of a coordination game, before any memory or interaction history is established.

Simulating repeated pairwise interactions within a decentralized population of LLM agents playing a 'naming game' to observe whether the group disproportionately converges on a specific arbitrary token as a universally adopted social convention.
